props.title: About Marcus
props.text: Filmmaker, cinematographer, and visual storyteller with over a decade of experience crafting authentic narratives for screen.

props.subtitle: The Story
props.title: A passion for visual storytelling
props.text: Marcus Cole is a filmmaker and cinematographer based in Los Angeles. With roots in documentary filmmaking and a deep love for cinematic craft, he brings a thoughtful, story-first approach to every project — whether it's a feature film, a brand campaign, or a music video.

props.subtitle: Philosophy
props.title: How I approach every project
props.text: Every frame should serve the story. Every choice — from lens selection to lighting — should be intentional.
props.leftText: I believe filmmaking is a collaborative art. The best work happens when there's trust between the director, the crew, and the talent. I bring a calm, focused energy to set and work closely with every department to ensure we're all telling the same story.
props.rightText: My background spans narrative films, documentaries, commercials, and music videos. This range has given me a versatile eye and the ability to adapt my approach to the unique demands of each project. I'm as comfortable on a run-and-gun doc shoot as I am on a fully crewed commercial set.

props.subtitle: Journey
props.title: The path so far
props.text: Key milestones that have shaped my career and craft.

items.title: Started in documentary filmmaking
items.text: Began shooting independent documentaries, learning to find story in real moments and available light.

items.title: First commercial projects
items.text: Transitioned into commercial work, bringing a cinematic sensibility to brand storytelling and campaign films.

items.title: Expanded into narrative & music videos
items.text: Took on narrative short films and music videos, collaborating with artists and directors across genres.

items.title: Full-service filmmaker
items.text: Now working across all formats — directing, shooting, and overseeing post-production for clients and collaborators worldwide.

props.quote: Marcus brought a level of craft and intention to our project that elevated everything. His eye for light and motion is extraordinary.
props.name: Sarah Chen

props.title: Want to work together?
props.text: I'm always open to new collaborations. Whether you have a project in mind or just want to say hello, let's connect.
